content: Rolapitant is a medication used in combination with other drugs to prevent delayed nausea and vomiting caused by chemotherapy. It is typically taken orally, with or without food, as directed by your doctor, usually within two hours before receiving chemotherapy. Always read the patient information leaflet provided by your pharmacist before starting this medication and each time you get a refill. Common side effects of rolapitant may include stomach upset or mouth sores. However, remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits to you outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. If you experience any unusual or severe symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. This is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. Before using rolapitant, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that can cause allergic reactions or other problems. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed, and it is unknown if it passes into breast milk. Consult your healthcare provider for guidance. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk for serious side effects. Rolapitant can slow the removal of other medications from your body, potentially affecting how they work. This effect can last for four weeks or longer after your dose of rolapitant. Conversely, other medications can affect the removal of rolapitant from your body, which may impact its effectiveness. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if someone has serious symptoms such as passing out or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. If you miss a dose, it is important to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. Store rolapitant at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
